briefdescription.para: Generic request-facing CRUDS handler: validates and authorizes a request, then delegates persistence to Controller.

detaileddescription.para: Declares EntityController<T>, the class that turns an HTTP request body into a validated, authorized entity and then hands it to the lower-level Controller for persistence. For each of the ten operations it follows the same recipe: parse JSON, validate against the entity schema, ask GateKeeper for permission, build the entity, and call the matching Controller method. The .cpp file holds the definitions.

WHY THIS FILE MATTERS IN THE SERVER: This is the bridge between "a request came in" and "a row was written". The generic ClientController and ClinicController both inherit from it, reusing its Read/Search/Update flows. Without this class each entity type would need its own copy of the parse-validate-authorize-delegate pipeline, and validation/security rules would drift.
